title: Polished Crystal TM & HM Locations: Complete List, Rewards & Map Guide
description: Find TM and HM locations in Pokémon Polished Crystal, including gym rewards, shop purchases, Game Corner prizes, hidden items, moves, and map links.
html:
Introduction

This guide is a lookup for the 75 TMs and 6 HMs documented for Polished Crystal. Use the numbered tables to find a machine, or start with the Moves database when you know the move but not its number. Every row connects the machine to its move, acquisition method, and location.

Quick answer: where to find TMs and HMs

Start with the HM table for HM01–HM06, or jump to the numbered TM tables for TM01–TM75. The tables link to the relevant item, move, and location pages. If you know the move but not its machine number, use the Moves database.

TM and HM lookup

  • HM locations
  • TM01–TM25
  • TM26–TM50
  • TM51–TM75
  • Find a move by name in the Moves database

TMs and HMs are listed separately because HMs support progression while TMs are grouped by number. Check the acquisition and location columns for the exact way to obtain each machine.

Department Store Purchases

Goldenrod and Celadon both have TMs for sale. Goldenrod Dept Store 5F sells:

  • TM14 Blizzard, TM15 Hyper Beam, TM16 Light Screen
  • TM17 Protect, TM22 Solar Beam, TM25 Thunder
  • TM27 Return, TM33 Reflect, TM38 Fire Blast

Celadon Dept Store 3F sells:

  • TM04 Calm Mind, TM07 Hail, TM08 Bulk Up
  • TM11 Sunny Day, TM18 Rain Dance, TM20 Safeguard
  • TM37 Sandstorm, TM75 Swords Dance

Game Corner Prizes

These are Game Corner prizes; check the linked entries for the listed locations.

Available at Goldenrod Game Corner:

  • TM13 Ice Beam
  • TM24 Thunderbolt
  • TM35 Flamethrower

Celadon Game Corner Prize Room has some good ones too:

  • TM06 Toxic
  • TM32 Double Team
  • TM68 Giga Impact

Tips

Gym TMs usually match the leader's type.

A lot of TMs are hidden items! If you're missing one, grab the Itemfinder and check the area again. I've missed plenty of hidden items on first pass.
